games.how: Digital branch from the paused game with rebuilt hands and libraries. Depthshaker Titan (51 trample) knocked out Fusion and Claude in one combat (a tie for last), then Sam's seat finished Michael. Final life: Sam 18.
confounds: Not a continuation of the human game: hands and libraries were rebuilt from deck files.
One mind (Claude) played three of four seats and knew Sam's hand.
Claude chose the attack that knocked out its own seat.

note: Commander games at the Divinci Table. Claude = Claude Code driving a seat through the table's API. Fusion = a Divinci release (RAG over the Magic rules plus its deck; model chain gemini-3-5-flash, falling back to Gemma 4 26B and Kimi K2.6). Only FINISHED games count toward placements; a seat a person or another AI piloted is 'assisted' and left out. Three games is an anecdote, not a ranking.
